newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices recover after fall on political woes.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices recover after fall on political woes.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Monday recovered to 1,177/1,178 rupees per quintal, on short-covering after an initial fall to 1,172/1,173 rupees on political worries that have gripped the country, dealers said.
On Sunday, the Congress party said it was withdrawing support to the United Front government and wished to form a government on its own, sparking a fresh round of political turmoil.
"Trading volumes remained slow as major players kept to the sidelines as they were busy with their books of account due to the last day of the fiscal year," one operator said.
"I am expecting narrow movement in coming days," he added.

Groundnut oil rose to 355/356 rupees per 10 kg from 352/353 rupees amid a shortage of ready stock in the absence of fresh arrivals due to the April 1 strike called by the transport industry. Transport operators are threatening to strike to protest against a service tax and hike in the insurance premium.
Imported palm oil also moved up from 281/282 rupees to 284/285 rupees per 10 kg for the same reason. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 530/535 rupees per 15 kg.
"If the strike by the transporters continue for a long time then a glut will emerge in the producing centres while consuming centres will face a shortage and price rise," one miller said.
